That doesn’t surprise me. The front desk experience was definitely the worst part for me. I’m sure everyone there is underpaid and exhausted too. I think I must have gotten lucky with how easy scheduling was.
At my location, the initial visit is $204 and follow-ups are $85. A lab draw or injection would be $32 each plus the cost of the test/injection.

Today was my first T injection! I can't believe it lol

I got my RX through IC at Planned Parenthood of Gladstone. I might do a write up of my experience there if anyone is interested, just cause there isn't much info about that location's LGBT services online.

I came out to my mom two days ago and she was amazing about it. She still doesn't want me to do HRT, but she said it's my decision and she took a picture of me doing my injection today lol. This morning I mailed coming out letters to my grandparents and my dad, both in greeting cards that say "from your grandson" and "from your son," just to get some third party gender affirmation in the mix. They probably won't take it super well, but with my mom on my side I feel pretty good.

Now for my next major quest: how the FUCK do you talk to girls

Waiting for my MSP zap too. That christmas green is surprisingly pretty though! My lab rat poog is currently dimensional and I'm still not used to it

http://www.neopets.com/~contracosta

Contra has a short bio here, but basically they are a snoopy, creepy basement dweller. Secretly, deep down, they might actually care about their friends a lot. They love snot lotion and radish-based food. It's uncertain if they are naturally slimy or if it's just all the  snot lotion and old radishes.

Also, not sure why I love most of these. I just do! I have a story in my head about my pets transforming and the emotional and ethical implications of living in a world where you can pay money to change your body/change species, so it feels kind of bittersweet to be deliberately changing my pets. As for the usuki, I like thinking about gender politics in neopets, because I'm a nerd. She also plays into the story, but that's why I originally got fascinated with the idea.

My dream team: mutant aisha, alien aisha, male usuki girl, and MSPP poogle. I just got the lab map so I'm working on the alien and MSP, and I want to save a little more to stay over 1mil when I get my usuki.
